items.title: Blue Tsunami, Same Waters? US Foreign Policy after the Midterms
items.excerpt: After the Democratic landslide in the US midterms, the Congress could challenge key policies of the Trump administration, starting with the war against Iran, disengagement from Europe and even military support to Israel.But the President retains broad discretion over international affairs.
